identification: Three Liberty London men's long-sleeve shirts, Made in Portugal, purple Liberty London woven neck labels and hangtags still attached (appear new with tags). Prints: blue medallion geometric, dark floral (Liberty-style ditsy), blue/yellow paisley. Catalogue says collar 16 1/2; neck tabs in photos read about 16.5 and 17 (paisley reads 17), so sizes may vary. Liberty uses Tana Lawn cotton, retail about GBP 155-175 each new.

viewing_check: Estimate $80-120 for the three, current bid $40 (+22% premium, about $49 at that bid). Photos show tags still attached, so likely new. Check the actual collar sizes (catalogue says 16 1/2, the paisley neck tab reads 17), and that they are genuine Liberty London label (yes, woven labels and hangtags visible). Resale prices for used Liberty Tana Lawn shirts mostly A$30-90 each, new with tags may fetch more; sales are 2023 to 2026, steady, no clear trend.
